section_summary.extract_value: This is an introductory section that reviews literature on body image in women, discussing how societal pressures regarding physical appearance are prevalent in socioeconomically developed settings and how negative body image is associated with disordered eating, weight-related outcomes, and psychological well-being. The section does not present any empirical studies or report specific study data.
